sentences.en: The house looks circular, but it isn't a complete circle.
sentences.zh: 这栋房子看起来是圆形的，但并不是一个完整的圆。

sentences.en: I really like him, but not his circle of friends.
sentences.zh: 我真的喜欢他，但不喜欢他的朋友圈。

sentences.en: The five of us stood in a circle holding hands.
sentences.zh: 我们五个人手牵手围成一个圈站着。

senses.zh: 圆，圆周；圈，环状物 - 圈子，界，社会，集团 -
